site.name: Ahmed Eldegla

site.heroTitle: I build *.NET* backends with the discipline of seven years in *C++*.
site.heroLead: I'm Ahmed Eldegla, a backend developer building RESTful APIs with ASP.NET Core, EF Core and SQL Server, structured with Clean Architecture and CQRS. Before .NET I spent seven years as a freelance C++ engineer in real-time networking, where slow or unstable code shows up right away.
site.aboutStatement: From inspecting live game traffic packet by packet to designing clean REST APIs, what I care about is the same: code that stays fast, predictable, and easy to debug.

aboutColumns.title: What I bring from C++
aboutColumns.body: Seven years of freelance C++ in real-time networking and game systems: multithreading, profiling, and tracking down crashes and memory issues with debuggers. It taught me to read unfamiliar code quickly and to care about latency and stability.

aboutColumns.title: What I build now
aboutColumns.body: RESTful APIs with ASP.NET Core, EF Core and SQL Server, structured with Clean Architecture and CQRS (MediatR), secured with JWT and ASP.NET Core Identity, and documented with Swagger.

site.contactHeadline: Need a backend developer? Let's talk.
site.contactText: Email me, or book a call directly.
site.seoDescription: Ahmed Eldegla - Backend developer (.NET & C++) building ASP.NET Core APIs with Clean Architecture and CQRS, with 7+ years in software and a background in real-time C++ networking.

projects.title: DEPI Smart Freelance Platform
projects.summary: The backend of a freelance marketplace: projects, proposals, milestone contracts, escrow wallets, messaging, reviews, guilds and communities. I was the team's top contributor and repository owner.
bullets: Structured the solution in 4 layers (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API) with Clean Architecture and CQRS via MediatR.
Implemented authentication and authorization with ASP.NET Core Identity and JWT, including role/permission management and user sessions.
Designed the SQL Server data model with EF Core, fixed shadow foreign-key mapping issues, and delivered SQL scripts and backups for the data analysis team.
Added global exception-handling middleware, MediatR logging behaviors, request validation, rate limiting, health checks, and GitHub Actions workflows.

projects.title: Cashier POS System

projects.title: Smart Accountant
projects.summary: A dashboard for accounting workflows that gives business owners a clear view of their numbers.

experience.title: C++ Networking Developer

bullets: Developed C++ extensions for real-time game clients, using static and dynamic binary analysis to understand undocumented systems.
Diagnosed complex crashes and memory issues with runtime debuggers and memory analysis tools.
